headline_marked: Trump says [[war with Iran will end soon]], Hormuz deal near
headline: Trump says war with Iran will end soon, Hormuz deal near
summary: US President Donald Trump claims a peace deal is imminent, while admitting the US military faces shortages of certain high-power weapons.
details: US President Donald Trump has stated that the ongoing conflict with Iran will end soon, suggesting that a deal regarding the Strait of Hormuz is close. He believes the Iranian side will not be able to sustain the conflict for much longer.
During a press briefing at the Oval Office, Trump admitted that while the US has unlimited stocks of some powerful weapons, the military is facing shortages of other specific types of munitions.

Reports indicate that the US Army has used a significant portion of its long-range precision missiles during the five-month war with Iran. In response, defense companies are now establishing new factories to produce Patriot and Tomahawk missiles.
Meanwhile, Iran's Deputy Foreign Minister Karim Gharibabadi noted that Tehran is receiving 'positive' messages from the US, though he did not disclose the nature or source of these communications.
Gharibabadi emphasized that for talks to proceed, bilateral issues with Oman must be resolved first, and new boundaries must be established in the Strait of Hormuz.
Despite the talk of peace, tensions remain high. Explosions were recently reported near Kishm Island, which Iran claims were part of operations against 'hostile targets'.

The Iranian Parliament is also discussing a draft bill to tighten control over the Strait of Hormuz, which would ban ships from 'hostile countries' like the US and Israel and impose fines on violators.
Additionally, Iran's Ministry of Intelligence announced the arrest of 21 people in Kerman province on charges of working for the Israeli intelligence agency, Mossad.

headline_marked: Content creator [[Ripon Mia arrested for rape]] of 15-year-old girl in Netrokona
headline: Content creator Ripon Mia arrested for rape of 15-year-old girl in Netrokona
summary: The accused allegedly lured the victim with promises of social media fame. Police intervened after a video of an illegal village arbitration settlement circulated online.
details: A Rab team arrested content creator Ripon Mia from the Mohisharon Achintapur area in Gouripur early yesterday morning.
The victim's father filed a case on August 5 under the Women and Children Repression Prevention Act, 2000, following an incident on July 30.
Ripon Mia, a neighbor of the victim, allegedly lured the girl to the bank of the Mogra river by promising to make her viral on social media before raping her.
Netrokona Sadar Model Police Station OC Abul Khayer stated that local influential people had initially tried to settle the matter through a village arbitration.
The arbitration reportedly fined the accused Tk 5 lakh and ordered him to leave the area instead of legal action.
Police contacted the victim's family and encouraged them to file a formal case after a video of the arbitration process circulated on social media.
Ripon Mia had been absconding until his arrest by the Rab-14 Mymensingh Battalion.
caption:
Lured by promises of social media fame, a 15-year-old girl was allegedly raped. The suspect was arrested after an illegal village settlement attempt failed.

A Rab team arrested content creator Ripon Mia from the Mohisharon Achintapur area in Gouripur early yesterday morning.

The victim's father filed a case on August 5 under the Women and Children Repression Prevention Act, 2000, following an incident on July 30.

Ripon Mia, a neighbor of the victim, allegedly lured the girl to the bank of the Mogra river by promising to make her viral on social media before raping her.

Netrokona Sadar Model Police Station OC Abul Khayer stated that local influential people had initially tried to settle the matter through a village arbitration.

The arbitration reportedly fined the accused Tk 5 lakh and ordered him to leave the area instead of legal action.

Police contacted the victim's family and encouraged them to file a formal case after a video of the arbitration process circulated on social media.

Ripon Mia had been absconding until his arrest by the Rab-14 Mymensingh Battalion.
